title: probes.json
description: The probe tasks a prune run reads, one per § under test. A probe is a small, realistic change request whose easiest solution breaks the rule, and it never mentions the rule. scripts/prune.mjs reads it; prune.json copies each probe word for word.

section.description: The § id the probe tests, such as §3.1. Each § has at most one probe.

probe.description: The whole task text an agent receives after the arm's text, including any instruction on how to finish.
